description: Header file defining the AudioResampler class for audio sample rate conversion, including quality settings, creation method, and resampling interface.

classes.name: AudioResampler
classes.description: Abstract class for audio resampling with different quality levels, supporting creation, configuration, and resampling of audio data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an AudioResampler with specified format, channel count, sample rate, and quality.

methods.name: setSampleRate
methods.description: Set the input sample rate for the resampler.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Set the left and right volume levels.

methods.name: resample
methods.description: Resample input audio data from a provider into an output buffer.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reset the internal state of the resampler.

methods.name: getUnreleasedFrames
methods.description: Get the number of frames that have not yet been output.

methods.name: getQuality
methods.description: Retrieve the current quality setting of the resampler.
